description: 352 offline HTML games, each on a single file

detail.readme:
A collection of offline HTML games.

A repo filled with 352 offline games that can each run on a single file. No CDNs are used. This is a good option if you are having internet connectivity issues, or you're at some place with restricted internet.

Most of these games are from the [Ultimate Game Stash](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_FmH3BlSBQI7FGgAQL59-ZPe8eCxs35wel6JUyVaG8Q) but turned offline. **Usage:** Under the Code button, select Download ZIP. It may take a while to download. After, extract the zip by right clicking on it and selecting Extract All. Now you have the repo containing the games all in a folder. You can also clone the repository using git. The downside of inlining everything is the file size. If you're running the files via a code editor, it's better to use **single-file.html**. It lets you fetch the files from the web or import your own.
